entry.title: How to Design AI Systems That Adapt Seamlessly to Model Updates
entry.summary:
AI systems are often fragile. When you change the model, everything breaks. That’s a problem many companies face, yet it’s rarely discussed openly. The core issue is deceptively simple. AI systems are designed to be rigid and tightly coupled to specific models. When a new model comes along, the whole system falls apart. Swapping large language models (LLMs) is not like changing a light bulb. It’s not as easy as plugging in something new and expecting everything to work. The truth is, these transitions often create chaos because AI systems are rarely built with flexibility in mind. Why Most AI Systems Break
